You ask the question with one hand and take the answer with the other. The key is already under your palm.

Rules

Action

One adjacent visible Bulk 0 or 1 object that is unattended or unsecured in a pocket or pouch.

A free hand.
Type

Make a Guile roll and take the object into a free hand.

Weak
An observer notices your hand after the object is taken.

Take it without immediate notice.

Take it without immediate notice and leave a harmless substitute you already hold.
